title: {Syn} RAG Lets Language Models Look Things Up
content:
Retrieval-augmented generation combines a language model with an external retrieval step. Instead of relying only on parameters, the model can condition on retrieved documents.

RAG is useful when answers depend on private, recent, or detailed knowledge that should be grounded in a source collection.

Why it matters: ai papers keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
